text.id: Hari 7. Rabu. Kapal pertama ke Pulau Pari isinya kita, karung-karung beras, dan satu kambing yang lebih tenang dari semua penumpang.
text.en: Day 7. Wednesday. The first boat to Pulau Pari carries us, sacks of rice, and one goat calmer than any of the passengers.

text.id: Gue mabok laut. Gue nggak pernah bilang ke Sekar. Tiap liputan pulau gue minum antimo dua.
text.en: I get seasick. I never told Sekar. Every island story, I took two motion sickness pills.

text.id: Gue bawa printout email-nya. Tiga lembar. Kalau HP kita mati semua.
text.en: I brought a printout of the email. Three copies. In case all our phones die.

text.id: HP gue geter. Ipda Yusuf. "Saya di kapal polisi jam 06.30. Pak Aditya ikut, sebagai 'perwakilan perusahaan'. Saya usahakan lambat."
text.en: My phone buzzes. Inspector Yusuf. "I'm on the police boat at 06:30. Mr. Aditya is coming, as a 'company representative'. I'll try to be slow."

text.id: Pari itu ada tiga dermaga, Ka. Seribu orang. Homestay di mana-mana. Kita mulai dari mana?
text.en: Pari has three jetties, Ka. A thousand people. Homestays everywhere. Where do we even start?

text.id: Ada satu nama di kepala lo, dan lo nggak tahu datengnya dari mana. Kayak halaman buku yang pernah lo baca, di minggu yang lain.
text.en: There's a name in your head, and you don't know where it came from. Like a page from a book you read in some other week.

text.id: "Kita cari kapal biru-putih. Namanya Sri Rejeki."
text.en: "We look for a blue and white boat. The Sri Rejeki."
(It's only a feeling. Go with what you know.)

text.id: "Pulau Pari itu gede, Ka." Di mana dia?
text.en: "Pari's a big island, Ka." Where is she?

text.id: Itu cuma bilang dia ke Pari. Gue butuh yang bilang di Pari-nya di mana.
text.en: That only says she went to Pari. I need something that says where on Pari.

text.id: Kapalnya merapat jam tujuh. Gue nunjukin layar HP ke ibu-ibu penjual gorengan di dermaga. Dia langsung nunjuk ke timur. "Dermaga bakau. Rumah sepupunya Pak Hendra."
text.en: The boat docks at seven. I show my screen to a woman selling fritters on the jetty. She points east right away. "The mangrove jetty. Pak Hendra's cousin's house."
